title: ServiceAccount
description: A credential for CI that is not a person. It is named after the organisation, as <organisation>:<metadata.name>, has no email address and cannot sign in. It always holds the member role, so it cannot invite people or mint further credentials. Applying a new ServiceAccount creates it and returns its API key and secret once, in the apply result's status (status.apiKey and status.secret): they are never shown again, by plan, export or the console, so store them as the apply returns them. Applying needs an owner or admin. Deleting the document deactivates the service account, so its key stops working; it is kept for the audit trail, and its name cannot be used again.

metadata.description: The name is 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, such as ci-scanner.

spec.description: A service account has nothing to declare beyond its name.
